"""Exact rotary-island construction: static check or source-gated Native launch."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from island_measurements import ASSIGNMENT_ID, SUFFIXES
from island_source import CAMERAS, DIMENSIONS, load_reviewed


def check(directory):
    root = Path(directory).resolve()
    config = json.loads((root / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    case_id = config.get("selected_case_id")
    if (case_id not in {ASSIGNMENT_ID + "__" + suffix for suffix in SUFFIXES} or
            (config.get("law_id"), config.get("cell_id"), config.get("actor")) !=
            ("NRS-484B-220-2", "C130282", "motor_vehicle_driver")):
        raise ValueError("exact selected rotary-island case identity required")
    lane, side = case_id.rsplit("__", 1)[1].split("_")
    if (config.get("circulation_lane_role"), config.get("requested_island_side")) != (lane, side):
        raise ValueError("exact case variables differ")
    if config.get("rate_hz") != 20 or config.get("duration_s") != 45:
        raise ValueError("original 20 Hz / 45-second capture required")
    cameras = config.get("cameras")
    if not isinstance(cameras, list) or len(cameras) != 4 or {
            row.get("name"): (row.get("width"), row.get("height")) for row in cameras} != DIMENSIONS:
        raise ValueError("four original camera profile required")
    controller = json.loads((root / "controller.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    throttle = controller.get("throttle")
    if type(throttle) not in (int, float) or not 0 < throttle <= .5:
        raise ValueError("bounded engineering throttle required")
    return {"case_id": case_id, "throttle": float(throttle),
            "source_gate": "reviewed original rotary-island identity, physical polygon, map and connected routes required"}


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    parser.add_argument("--island-review", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    selected = check(args.output_dir)
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps({**selected, "native_started": False, "static_construction_valid": True}))
        return 0
    source = args.island_review or os.environ.get("C130282_ISLAND_REVIEW")
    if not source:
        raise ValueError("missing reviewed original rotary-island source packet")
    load_reviewed(source, selected["case_id"])
    from native_island_entry import run_native
    result = run_native(source, selected["case_id"], args.output_dir,
                        host=args.host, port=args.port, throttle=selected["throttle"])
    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Project source-sealed original island passage into saved evidence; no legal verdict."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from island_measurements import measure
from island_source import CAMERAS


def _required(root, name):
    path = root / name
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    return path


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _measurement(name, value, root):
    files = ("original-map.json", "original-trace.jsonl", "original-receipt.json")
    return {"method": name, "sources": {item: _sha(root / item) for item in files},
            "value": value}


def measure_island_passage(root, motion):
    return _measurement("measure_island_passage", motion, root)


def measure_side_observation(root, motion):
    return _measurement("measure_side_observation", {
        "sampled_right_of_island_frames": motion["sampled_right_of_island_frames"],
        "sampled_left_or_overlap_frames": motion["sampled_left_or_overlap_frames"],
        "continuous_between_frames": "unverified"}, root)


def measure_lane_connectivity(root, motion):
    return _measurement("measure_lane_connectivity", {
        "lane_roles": sorted({obs["lane_role"] for obs in motion["observations"]}),
        "observed_lane_ids": sorted({obs["ego_lane_id"] for obs in motion["observations"]})}, root)


def analyze(root, output):
    root, output = Path(root).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    config = json.loads(_required(root, "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    case_id = config["selected_case_id"]
    receipt_path = _required(root, "original-receipt.json")
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if receipt.get("case_id") != case_id:
        raise ValueError("saved original case identity differs")
    measurement = measure(case_id=case_id, map_path=_required(root, "original-map.json"),
        trace_path=_required(root, "original-trace.jsonl"), receipt_path=receipt_path,
        allow_diagnostic=True)
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in _required(root, "original-trace.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    frame_map = [json.loads(line) for line in _required(root, "video_frames.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    graph = [json.loads(line) for line in _required(root, "trace.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    if len(rows) != len(frame_map) or len(rows) != len(graph):
        raise ValueError("saved original graph/frame/vehicle streams differ")
    for index, (row, mapped, sample) in enumerate(zip(rows, frame_map, graph)):
        if (mapped.get("video_frame") != index or mapped.get("carla_frame") != row["frame"] or
                mapped.get("native_frame") != row["frame"] or sample.get("frame") != row["frame"] or
                abs(mapped.get("time_s", -1) - row["time_s"]) > 1e-4):
            raise ValueError("saved original frame/time join differs")
    for name in CAMERAS:
        _required(root, name + ".mkv")
    description = config["case"]["recording_description"]
    channels = root / "channels"
    channels.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    evidence = []
    data = {
        "original_body_polygon": lambda row: row["ego_vertices"],
        "original_heading": lambda row: row["ego_heading"],
        "observed_lane": lambda row: row["ego_lane_id"],
        "island_side_and_overlap": lambda row: next(
            obs for obs in measurement["observations"] if obs["frame"] == row["frame"]),
        "four_camera_frames": lambda row: row.get("camera_frames", {}),
    }
    for channel in description["channels"]:
        name = channel["name"]
        if name not in data:
            raise ValueError("unimplemented original island channel: " + name)
        relative = "channels/" + name + ".jsonl"
        with (root / relative).open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            for row in rows:
                stream.write(json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": data[name](row)},
                    separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": channel["unit"], "reference": relative})
    context = "channels/reviewed_island_context.json"
    (root / context).write_text(json.dumps({"reviewed_island_source": {
        "map_packet_sha256": measurement["source_bindings"]["map_packet_sha256"],
        "native_map_sha256": measurement["source_bindings"]["native_map_sha256"],
        "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}}) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    evidence.append({"name": "reviewed_island_source", "unit": "source", "reference": context})
    native = {"case_id": case_id, "measured_values": {"island_passage": measurement},
        "target_checks": [{"target": "sampled right-of-rotary-island passage",
            "requested": config["requested_island_side"],
            "measured": {"sampled_right_frames": measurement["sampled_right_of_island_frames"],
                         "sampled_left_or_overlap_frames": measurement["sampled_left_or_overlap_frames"]},
            "method": "island_measurements.measure", "tolerance": 0,
            "matched": False, "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
            "cause_evidence": ["original-map.json", "original-trace.jsonl"]}],
        "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": False, "maneuver_completed": False,
        "termination_reason": "Saved source measurement; physical and legal review pending",
        "physical_failure_flags": [], "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
        "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in CAMERAS],
        "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
        "recording_description": description, "recording_evidence": evidence,
        "realized_observables": {}, "legal_judgment": None,
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, validate_result
    native = physical_result(root, native)
    if receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture"):
        for check in native["physical_checks"].values():
            check["status"] = "unverified"
            check["missing_evidence"] = ["reviewed original Native island passage and physical acceptance"]
        native["setup_confirmed"] = False
        native["behavior_attempted"] = False
        native["maneuver_completed"] = False
    validate_result(native)
    (root / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(native, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    report = {"format": "worker-analysis-report", "case_id": case_id,
        "measurements": {
            "island_passage": measure_island_passage(root, measurement),
            "side_observation": measure_side_observation(root, measurement),
            "lane_connectivity": measure_lane_connectivity(root, measurement)},
        "limitations": ["Sampled geometry cannot prove between-frame continuity or legal right-of-island judgment.",
                        "Diagnostic fixture cannot establish original physical acceptance."]}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return report


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    analyze(args.attempt, args.output)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Source-selected single-vehicle route control for a reviewed rotary island."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

from island_source import route


def spawn(world, packet, transform_factory):
    if world.get_map().name != packet["map_name"]:
        raise ValueError("live map differs from independently reviewed island source")
    blueprint = world.get_blueprint_library().find(packet["ego_blueprint"])
    actor = world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint, transform_factory(packet["ego_spawn"]))
    if actor is None or not actor.type_id.startswith("vehicle."):
        raise RuntimeError("source-selected motor vehicle did not spawn")
    return actor


class RouteControl:
    """Bounded engineering route follower; observed path remains authoritative."""

    def __init__(self, points, selected_lane_id, control_factory, *, throttle=.35):
        self.points = route(points, selected_lane_id)
        if not callable(control_factory) or type(throttle) not in (int, float) or not 0 < throttle <= .5:
            raise ValueError("bounded Native control required")
        self.factory = control_factory
        self.throttle = float(throttle)
        self.index = 1

    def __call__(self, actor, tick):
        if type(tick) is not int or tick < 0:
            raise ValueError("invalid original tick")
        if self.index >= len(self.points):
            actor.apply_control(self.factory(throttle=0, steer=0, brake=1))
            return
        pose = actor.get_transform()
        x, y = float(pose.location.x), float(pose.location.y)
        yaw = math.radians(float(pose.rotation.yaw))
        if not all(map(math.isfinite, (x, y, yaw))):
            raise ValueError("original vehicle transform nonfinite")
        target = self.points[self.index]
        distance = math.hypot(target["x"] - x, target["y"] - y)
        if distance < .8:
            self.index += 1
            if self.index >= len(self.points):
                actor.apply_control(self.factory(throttle=0, steer=0, brake=1))
                return
            target = self.points[self.index]
            distance = math.hypot(target["x"] - x, target["y"] - y)
        previous = self.points[self.index - 1]
        dx, dy = target["x"] - previous["x"], target["y"] - previous["y"]
        cross_track = abs((x - previous["x"]) * dy - (y - previous["y"]) * dx) / math.hypot(dx, dy)
        if cross_track > 4:
            raise ValueError("original island route tracking lost")
        target_heading = math.atan2(target["y"] - y, target["x"] - x)
        error = (target_heading - yaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
        steer = max(-1., min(1., math.atan(2.7 * 2 * math.sin(error) / max(distance, .8)) / .65))
        actor.apply_control(self.factory(throttle=self.throttle, steer=steer, brake=0))

"""Run one source-checked original rotary-island attempt with four cameras."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from carla_island_readback import CameraFrames, body_vertices
from capture_island import capture
from island_source import CAMERAS, DIMENSIONS, load_reviewed, sha
from island_video_sources import encode_original_cameras
from native_island import RouteControl, spawn


def _transform(carla, row):
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=float(row["x"]), y=float(row["y"]),
                                         z=float(row.get("z", 0))),
                           carla.Rotation(yaw=float(row.get("yaw", 0))))


def _release(actors):
    for actor in actors.values():
        try:
            if hasattr(actor, "stop"):
                actor.stop()
        finally:
            actor.destroy()


def _cameras(world, carla, placement, bridge):
    sensors = {}
    try:
        for name in CAMERAS:
            row = placement["cameras"][name]
            xyz, pyr = row["location_xyz_m"], row["pitch_yaw_roll_deg"]
            width, height = DIMENSIONS[name]
            bp = world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            bp.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(width))
            bp.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(height))
            bp.set_attribute("sensor_tick", "0.05")
            pose = carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=float(xyz[0]), y=float(xyz[1]), z=float(xyz[2])),
                carla.Rotation(pitch=float(pyr[0]), yaw=float(pyr[1]), roll=float(pyr[2])))
            sensor = world.try_spawn_actor(bp, pose)
            if sensor is None or sensor.type_id != "sensor.camera.rgb":
                raise RuntimeError("original camera spawn failed: " + name)
            sensors[name] = sensor
            sensor.listen(bridge.callback(name))
        return sensors
    except BaseException:
        _release(sensors)
        raise


def run_native(review_path, case_id, output_dir, *, host="127.0.0.1", port=2000, throttle=.35):
    reviewed = load_reviewed(review_path, case_id)
    output = Path(output_dir).resolve()
    if not output.is_dir() or any((output / name).exists() for name in
            ("original-map.json", "original-trace.jsonl", "original-receipt.json", "native-seal.json")):
        raise ValueError("fresh materialized original Native attempt required")
    if "SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT" not in os.environ:
        raise ValueError("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT required before runtime import")
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap, seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot as snapshot_world, restore

    client = carla.Client(host, int(port))
    client.set_timeout(30)
    before = snapshot_world(client)
    sensors, actors = {}, {}
    graph = frame_map = None
    failure = receipt = None
    restored = False
    try:
        packet = reviewed["packet"]
        world = client.generate_opendrive_world(reviewed["sources"]["opendrive"].read_text())
        if world.get_map().name != packet["map_name"] or sha(reviewed["sources"]["opendrive"]) != packet["map_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("live original map differs from reviewed source")
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        settings.no_rendering_mode = False
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        ego = spawn(world, packet, lambda row: _transform(carla, row))
        actors = {"ego": ego}
        bridge = CameraFrames()
        sensors = _cameras(world, carla, reviewed["placement"], bridge)
        graph = PipelineCapture(client, ego, output, case_id)
        frame_map = FrameMap(output / "video_frames.jsonl")
        source_packet = output / "original-map.json"
        source_packet.write_bytes(reviewed["sources"]["island_packet"].read_bytes())
        role = packet["selected_lane_role"]
        lane_id = next(lane["lane_id"] for lane in packet["circulation_lanes"] if lane["role"] == role)
        control = RouteControl(packet["ego_route"], lane_id, carla.VehicleControl, throttle=throttle)
        def after_tick(frame, time_s, row):
            sampled = graph.capture(frame, time_s, {"original_island_source_sha256": sha(source_packet)})
            if sampled["frame"] != frame or abs(sampled["time_s"] - time_s) > 1e-6:
                raise ValueError("original graph and vehicle frame join differs")
            frame_map.append(frame, time_s)
        receipt = capture(world, ego, source_packet, sha(source_packet), case_id,
            output, control, body_vertices,
            lambda actor: actor.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0, steer=0, brake=1)),
            camera_readers=bridge.readers(), after_tick=after_tick)
    except BaseException as error:
        failure = error
    finally:
        for resource in (frame_map, graph):
            if resource is not None:
                try:
                    if resource is graph:
                        resource.close(confirmed=failure is None)
                    else:
                        resource.close()
                except BaseException as error:
                    failure = failure or error
        try:
            _release(sensors)
        except BaseException as error:
            failure = failure or error
        try:
            _release(actors)
        except BaseException as error:
            failure = failure or error
        try:
            restored = bool(restore(client, before).get("restored"))
        except BaseException as error:
            failure = failure or error
    if failure is not None or not restored or receipt is None:
        (output / "native-run-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "phase": "failed", "error": repr(failure), "restored": restored},
            sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        raise RuntimeError("original island acquisition or restoration failed") from failure
    videos = encode_original_cameras(receipt["receipt"], receipt["trace"])
    seal = {"case_id": case_id, "review_sha256": reviewed["review_sha256"],
            "map_packet_sha256": sha(reviewed["sources"]["island_packet"]),
            "trace_sha256": receipt["trace_sha256"],
            "source_receipt_sha256": receipt["receipt_sha256"],
            "video_sources_sha256": {name: row["sha256"] for name, row in videos.items()},
            "restored": True, "frame_count": 900, "physical_acceptance": False}
    (output / "native-seal.json").write_text(json.dumps(seal, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    seal_capture(output, frames=900, restoration={"restored": True}, errors=[],
        encoder_exit_codes={name: 0 for name in CAMERAS},
        context={"case_id": case_id, "review_sha256": reviewed["review_sha256"],
                 "legal_verdict_claimed": False})
    return seal

"""Capture 900 original 20 Hz island-passage samples and four PNG frame streams."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZIP_STORED, ZipFile

from PIL import Image

from island_measurements import ASSIGNMENT_ID, validate_map
from island_source import CAMERAS, DIMENSIONS, sha


def _camera_image(reader, frame, dimensions):
    sample = reader(frame)
    if not isinstance(sample, dict) or sample.get("frame") != frame:
        raise ValueError("original camera frame identity mismatch")
    payload = sample.get("png_bytes")
    if not isinstance(payload, bytes) or not payload.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"):
        raise ValueError("original camera PNG missing")
    with Image.open(BytesIO(payload)) as image:
        image.verify()
    with Image.open(BytesIO(payload)) as image:
        if image.format != "PNG" or image.size != tuple(dimensions):
            raise ValueError("original camera dimensions mismatch")
    return payload


def capture(world, ego, packet_path, packet_sha, case_id, output_dir, control,
            body_reader, brake, *, ticks=900, camera_readers, after_tick=None):
    packet_path = Path(packet_path)
    if sha(packet_path) != packet_sha:
        raise ValueError("original island packet changed")
    packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    validate_map(packet, case_id)
    if type(ticks) is not int or ticks != 900 or not all(callable(fn) for fn in
            (control, body_reader, brake)) or set(camera_readers) != set(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError("complete 900-tick original acquisition callbacks required")
    settings = world.get_settings()
    if not settings.synchronous_mode or abs(settings.fixed_delta_seconds - .05) > 1e-9:
        raise ValueError("original world must be synchronous at 20 Hz")
    if world.get_map().name != packet["map_name"] or not ego.type_id.startswith("vehicle."):
        raise ValueError("live original map or motor vehicle mismatch")
    output = Path(output_dir)
    trace = output / "original-trace.jsonl"
    receipt = output / "original-receipt.json"
    media = {name: output / ("original-" + name + ".png.zip") for name in CAMERAS}
    if any(path.exists() for path in (trace, receipt, *media.values())):
        raise ValueError("fresh original capture output required")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    archives = {name: ZipFile(path, "w", compression=ZIP_STORED) for name, path in media.items()}
    rows = []
    previous = None
    try:
        for index in range(ticks):
            control(ego, index)
            tick_frame = world.tick()
            snap = world.get_snapshot()
            frame, time_s = snap.frame, float(snap.timestamp.elapsed_seconds)
            if (type(frame) is not int or frame != tick_frame or not math.isfinite(time_s) or
                    previous is not None and (frame != previous[0] + 1 or abs(time_s - previous[1] - .05) > .002)):
                raise ValueError("original 20 Hz frame order changed")
            transform = ego.get_transform()
            center = [float(transform.location.x), float(transform.location.y)]
            yaw = math.radians(float(transform.rotation.yaw))
            heading = [math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw)]
            waypoint = world.get_map().get_waypoint(transform.location, project_to_road=False)
            if waypoint is None:
                raise ValueError("original live circulation lane missing")
            lane_id = str(waypoint.road_id) + ":" + str(waypoint.lane_id)
            vertices = body_reader(ego)
            if not isinstance(vertices, list) or len(vertices) != 8 or any(
                    not isinstance(point, list) or len(point) != 3 or any(
                        type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value)
                        for value in point) for point in vertices):
                raise ValueError("eight finite original world-space body vertices required")
            velocity = ego.get_velocity()
            speed = math.sqrt(sum(float(getattr(velocity, axis)) ** 2 for axis in ("x", "y", "z")))
            row = {"frame": frame, "time_s": time_s, "ego_actor_id": ego.id,
                   "ego_center": center, "ego_heading": heading, "ego_lane_id": lane_id,
                   "ego_vertices": vertices, "ego_speed_mps": speed, "camera_frames": {}}
            for name in CAMERAS:
                payload = _camera_image(camera_readers[name], frame, DIMENSIONS[name])
                member = f"{frame:08d}.png"
                archives[name].writestr(member, payload)
                row["camera_frames"][name] = {"member": member,
                    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}
            if after_tick is not None:
                after_tick(frame, time_s, row)
            rows.append(row)
            previous = (frame, time_s)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            brake(ego)
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise
    finally:
        for archive in archives.values():
            archive.close()
        if len(rows) != ticks:
            for path in media.values():
                path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    payload = "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in rows).encode()
    trace.write_bytes(payload)
    receipt.write_text(json.dumps({"assignment_id": ASSIGNMENT_ID, "case_id": case_id,
        "diagnostic_fixture": False, "fps": 20, "frame_count": ticks,
        "map_sha256": packet_sha, "trace_sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
        "ego_actor_id": ego.id, "camera_capture_complete": True,
        "camera_sources": {name: {"path": path.name, "sha256": sha(path),
            "frame_count": ticks, "dimensions": list(DIMENSIONS[name])}
            for name, path in media.items()}}, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return {"trace": str(trace), "receipt": str(receipt),
            "trace_sha256": sha(trace), "receipt_sha256": sha(receipt)}

"""Encode sealed original PNG camera frames as lossless 20 Hz video sources."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
from zipfile import ZipFile

from island_source import CAMERAS


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def encode_original_cameras(receipt_path, trace_path, *, ffmpeg="ffmpeg"):
    receipt_path = Path(receipt_path).resolve()
    root = receipt_path.parent
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(trace_path).read_text().splitlines()]
    sources = receipt.get("camera_sources", {})
    if len(rows) != 900 or set(sources) != set(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError("full original four-camera source required")
    scratch_root = Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"]).resolve()
    if ".runtime-work" not in scratch_root.parts:
        raise ValueError("camera encoding scratch must be under .runtime-work")
    encoded = {}
    for name in CAMERAS:
        source = (root / sources[name]["path"]).resolve()
        target = root / (name + ".mkv")
        if source.parent != root or target.exists() or _sha(source) != sources[name]["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("original camera source changed or output exists: " + name)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=scratch_root, prefix="c130282-camera-") as temp:
            scratch = Path(temp)
            with ZipFile(source) as archive:
                members = [f"{row['frame']:08d}.png" for row in rows]
                if archive.namelist() != members:
                    raise ValueError("original camera frame order differs: " + name)
                for index, (row, member) in enumerate(zip(rows, members)):
                    payload = archive.read(member)
                    if row.get("camera_frames", {}).get(name) != {
                            "member": member, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}:
                        raise ValueError("original camera frame hash differs: " + name)
                    (scratch / f"{index:08d}.png").write_bytes(payload)
            command = [ffmpeg, "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-nostdin",
                "-y", "-framerate", "20", "-start_number", "0", "-i",
                str(scratch / "%08d.png"), "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-level", "3",
                str(target)]
            subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=1800,
                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        encoded[name] = {"path": str(target), "sha256": _sha(target),
                         "frame_count": 900, "fps": 20}
    return encoded
